title: Hollow Signal
description: The town has gone quiet. Tune through the static and hold four clear signals before your sanity fades.
controls: A / D or left / right tune · mouse/touch drag tuning dial · hold Space or Hold Signal to rescue · P / Esc pause · R restart

zh-CN.title: 空镇回声
zh-CN.description: 雾锁小镇里还有人在呼救。转动电台旋钮，穿过杂音寻找四名幸存者，在理智耗尽前锁定信号并引导他们脱险。
zh-CN.controls: A / D 或左右方向键调频 · 鼠标或触屏拖动调频旋钮 · 按住空格或“锁定信号”救援 · P / Esc 暂停 · R 重开
